description: Checks that .ps1 files contain only ASCII characters (0x00-0x7F). Blocks saves that introduce Unicode symbols like arrows, checkmarks, or box-drawing characters.

command.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f = '${file}'; if ($f -notmatch '\.ps1$') { exit 0 }; $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f); $non = $bytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }; if ($non) { $lines = @(); $content = Get-Content $f; for ($i = 0; $i -lt $content.Length; $i++) { if ($content[$i] -match '[^\x00-\x7F]') { $lines += ($i + 1) } }; Write-Host '[FAIL] Non-ASCII characters found in' $f 'on line(s):' ($lines -join ', '); exit 2 } else { exit 0 }"
